verdict: M214 correctly makes an already terminal-hint-closed lone paired window load-eligible only on the authoritative upstream_done_accept edge. Independent current-source Synopsys VCS rejects wrong-tag and wrong-count unaccepted fences without an M214 load, preserves group identity through a 72-cycle stall, retains the legal bank-96 bound, and safely chains the next token header on the terminal retirement edge. Fresh M212 and M214 256-case sweeps reproduce 47 improved, 209 unchanged, zero regressed cases; the M214 recurrence has zero mismatch and both the model causal sum and VCS SVA cover are exactly 47. The pinned full-H67 opportunity result is internally consistent at 90,196,785 cycles, 191,982 below M212, or 1.002128479x. Exact-SHA 3 ns DC passes with 20,587.392080 um2 and no violated constraints, but has only 0.0004 ns setup slack under ideal-clock ZeroWireload conditions. M214 is admitted as an isolated sparse-FC2-frontend control-bubble ablation, not complete FC2, FFN, physical, system, or headline speedup.

frozen_h67_opportunity_r2_audit.method: Exact manifest and input identities plus independent arithmetic and stage aggregation audit; this review does not claim a second full 5.58M-token execution.

p1.finding: The full frozen isolated-frontend delta is only 191,982 cycles, or 1.002128479x versus M212; even M210-to-M214 is only about 1.01095x.
p1.effect: M214 is a clean control-bubble ablation but cannot carry a 2-3x DATE headline.
p1.required_action: Keep M214 as a mechanism ablation and obtain the paper-scale factor from a matched executable baseline that includes source skipping, weight service, accumulation, commit, and memory service.

p1.finding: The exact 3 ns logic-only setup path has only +0.0004 ns slack and the run receipt reports 0.0000 ns hold margin under ideal-clock ZeroWireload assumptions.
p1.effect: There is no demonstrated physical timing margin, and the done comparator now participates in a load-control cone.
p1.required_action: Require Formality, propagated-clock PT, target SRAM/macro integration, physical margin closure, and activity-based power before physical or energy claims.

p1.finding: The admitted module stops before weight supply, accumulation, result commit, and physical SRAM/DRAM behavior.
p1.effect: Complete-FC2, FFN, chip-level, and system performance remain unknown.
p1.required_action: Keep complete_fc2, ffN, physical_speedup, system_speedup, paper_ppa_ready, and headline false until those services share one executable cycle boundary.

p2.finding: The production regression does not itself hit bank-96 or terminal header-chain cover; those pass only in this independent review.
p2.next_target: Promote the independent bank-96, unaccepted-done, long-stall, and terminal-header-chain tests into the permanent fail-closed VCS suite.

p2.finding: The frozen r2 artifact intentionally still labels M214 RTL and VCS calibration false because it is an opportunity-model artifact, while separate evidence now proves the implementation.
p2.next_target: Create one admission index that links, without rewriting, the r2 opportunity artifact, exact VCS receipt, and exact DC receipt so later tables cannot cite r2 alone as implemented hardware.
